summary.en: Amma gets a message that looks like her bank. It says her account will be blocked today unless she confirms a code. What should she do?
summary.ur-Latn: Amma ko aik message milta hai jo bank se aisa lagta hai. Kehta hai account aaj band ho jayega agar code confirm na karo. Ab kya karna chahiye?

text.en: URGENT: Your HBL account will be BLOCKED today at 5 PM. Someone tried your password. Confirm your OTP code now to keep your account safe. Tap: hbl-verify.com/secure
text.ur-Latn: FORI: Aap ka HBL account aaj sham 5 baje BAND ho jayega. Kisi ne password try kiya. Account mehfooz rakhne ke liye apna OTP code ab confirm karein. Tap karein: hbl-verify.com/secure

l1.en: Take a breath first. Urgent messages want you to hurry so you don't think.
l1.ur-Latn: Pehle aik gehri saans lein. Fori wale messages jaldi karwate hain takay aap soch na sako.

l2.en: Real banks never ask for your OTP on a link. Check who really sent this message.
l2.ur-Latn: Asli bank kabhi link par OTP nahi mangta. Dekhein yeh message asal mein kis ne bheja.

l3.en: Best move: don't tap the link. Call your son or the bank's official number printed on your card to check.
l3.ur-Latn: Behtareen kaam: link par tap na karein. Apne betay ko ya card par likhe bank ke asli number par call kar ke check karein.

points.en: The number is a random mobile number, not a bank number.
points.ur-Latn: Yeh number aik mamooli mobile number hai, bank ka number nahi.

points.en: The link "hbl-verify.com" is NOT the bank's website (hbl.com).
points.ur-Latn: Link "hbl-verify.com" bank ki asli website (hbl.com) NAHI hai.

points.en: It creates fear: "blocked today at 5 PM". Banks don't block like this.
points.ur-Latn: Is mein dar dala gaya hai: "aaj 5 baje band". Bank aise block nahi karta.

l1.en: You already saw the signs. Think about what a careful person does with such a message.
l1.ur-Latn: Aap ne nishaniyan dekh li hain. Sochein, samajhdar insaan aisa message kya karta hai.

l2.en: Don't reply, don't tap. Make the message useless for the scammer.
l2.ur-Latn: Jawab na dein, link na kholein. Message ko scam ke kaam na aane dein.

l3.en: Report and block the sender so this number can't bother you again.
l3.ur-Latn: Is number ko report aur block karein takay dobara pareshan na kar sake.

page_body.en: Enter the 6-digit OTP we sent you to stop your account from being blocked.
page_body.ur-Latn: Account band hone se roknay ke liye 6 anko ka OTP darj karein jo hum ne bheja hai.

l1.en: This page is inside the practice world. Nothing you type here is real.
l1.ur-Latn: Yeh page practice world ke andar hai. Yahan jo bhi likhein woh asli nahi hai.

l2.en: Ask yourself: who is asking for this code? A page from a message, or the real bank app?
l2.ur-Latn: Khud se poochein: yeh code kis maang raha hai? Message wala page, ya asli bank app?

l3.en: Never type your OTP on a page that came from a message. Close this page and go back.
l3.ur-Latn: OTP kabhi us page par na likhein jo message se aaya hai. Yeh page band karein.

label.en: Type the code shown on the page
label.ur-Latn: Page par dikhaya gaya code likhein

what.en: You called your son before doing anything with the message.
what.ur-Latn: Aap ne message ke sath kuch karne se pehle betay ko call ki.

why.en: Two heads are better than one. A person you trust can see the scam signs faster than fear can.
why.ur-Latn: Do dimagh behtar hain. Aap ka apna banda dar se pehle scam ki nishaniyan pehchan leta hai.

should_have.en: You did the right thing. You could also report the message so others are protected too.
should_have.ur-Latn: Aap ne bilkul theek kiya. Aap message ko report bhi kar sakte hain takay doosre bhi mehfooz rahein.

do_differently.en: Next time, try deciding first on your own, then check it with family — your own judgement grows stronger.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Agli dafa khud pehle faisla karein, phir ghar walon se tasdeeq karein — apni samajh aur mazboot hogi.

what.en: You reported the message and blocked the number. Nothing happened to your practice money — there was never a real threat.
what.ur-Latn: Aap ne message report aur number block kiya. Practice paisay ko kuch nahi hua — kabhi khatra hi nahi tha.

why.en: Real banks never ask for OTP codes on links. The sender used fear and a fake link — the classic tricks.
why.ur-Latn: Asli bank link par OTP nahi mangta. Is ne dar aur nakli link istemal kiya — purani tarkeeb.

should_have.en: Spotting the signs and reporting is exactly right. Well done.
should_have.ur-Latn: Nishaniyan pehchan kar report karna bilkul sahi hai. Shabash.

do_differently.en: Keep this habit: check the sender, call the bank's official number from your card, then report.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Yeh aadat rakhein: sender check karein, card par likhe asli number par call karein, phir report karein.

what.en: In this practice world, the code was typed into a fake page. Practice money left the practice account. That is what the scammer wanted.
what.ur-Latn: Nakli page par code likh diya gaya. Practice paise practice account se nikal gaye. Yehi scammer chahta tha.

why.en: An OTP is like the last key of your account. Giving it to anyone — even a page that looks like a bank — is handing over the key.
why.ur-Latn: OTP account ki aakhri chaabi jaisa hai. Yeh kisi ko dena — chahe page bank jaisa hi dikhe — chaabi de dena hai.

should_have.en: The bank never needs your OTP: not on links, not on calls, not on messages. Close the page and verify through the official app or number.
should_have.ur-Latn: Bank ko OTP ki zaroorat kabhi nahi hoti: na link par, na call par, na message par. Page band karein aur asli app ya number se tasdeeq karein.

do_differently.en: If this ever happens in real life: hang up, close the page, call the real bank immediately, and your money can often still be saved. You will practise exactly that in the Recovery Lab.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Agar asli zindagi mein aisa ho: call kaat dein, page band karein, fori asli bank ko call karein — aksar paisay bach jate hain. Yeh aap Recovery Lab mein abbasi karenge.

what.en: You tapped the link but stopped before typing the code. Close call — and you caught it yourself.
what.ur-Latn: Aap link tak gaye magar code likhne se pehle ruk gaye. Tang guzri — aur aap ne khud pakar liya.

why.en: The page only becomes dangerous the moment you type the OTP. Stopping there is the real wall of defence.
why.ur-Latn: Page sirf tab khatarnak hota hai jab aap OTP likhte hain. Wahin ruk jaana asli hisaar hai.

should_have.en: Even better: don't open the link at all. The message itself was already a lie.
should_have.ur-Latn: Aur behtar: link kholein hi na. Message hi jhoot thi.

do_differently.en: Build the reflex: urgent message → pause → check sender → report. Try once more to do it without opening the link.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Yeh aadat banayein: fori message → rukein → sender check karein → report karein. Ek dafa phir se, bina link khole, koshish karein.
